attenuation.docs:
Only on ESP32. Specify the ADC attenuation to use. See [ESP32 Attenuation](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/adc#esp32-attenuation). Defaults to `0db`.

*See also: [Analog To Digital Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/adc#configuration-variables)*

pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The pin to measure the voltage on. Or on the ESP8266 or Raspberry Pi Pico it could alternatively be set to `VCC`, see [Measuring VCC](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/adc#adc-vcc).

*See also: [Analog To Digital Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/adc#configuration-variables)*

raw.docs:
Allows to read the raw ADC output without any conversion or calibration. See [Different ESP32-ADC behavior since 2021.11](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/adc#adc-raw). Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Analog To Digital Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/adc#configuration-variables)*

samples.docs:
The amount of ADC readings to take per sensor update. On the ESP32 this value is ignored if `attenuation` is set to `auto`. Defaults to `1`.

*See also: [Analog To Digital Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/adc#configuration-variables)*

sampling_mode.docs:
Sampling method to use when multiple samples are taken.

*See also: [Analog To Digital Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/adc#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [Analog To Digital Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/adc#configuration-variables)*
